tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Brand accent. Primary buttons, active tab, focus ring, selected chips, links. Text on `bg`/`primary-subtle` (5.5:1 light, 10:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover state of primary buttons; text on `primary-subtle`.

tokens.name: color-primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected chips, active nav pill, Submitted pill, focus halo.

tokens.name: color-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed ON a `primary` fill (white on teal; dark teal on bright dark-mode teal).

tokens.name: color-saffron
tokens.usage: LOGO ONLY (mark detail, app icon). Never used for UI states, text or warnings.

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Screen background and card fill.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Secondary surface: recon card body, list group headers, locked section cards.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px dividers and card outlines. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, chip and segmented edges. 3:1 against `bg` so fields are findable in sunlight.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: All numbers and body text on `bg`, `surface`, `auto-field-bg` (17:1 light).

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, helper text, units. 7.6:1 on `bg` in light; AAA.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, opening-reading caption, placeholders. Never for values, errors or actions. at least 4.5:1 on every ground (darker than the brief's #94A3B8, which was 2.6:1).

tokens.name: color-auto-field-bg
tokens.usage: Fill for AUTO (calculated, read-only) fields and auto totals. Inputs are white; autos are grey.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Matched / within tolerance. Text and icon on `bg` and `success-subtle` (7:1 light). Reserved for state.

tokens.name: color-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background for Matched pill, banner and calendar cell.

tokens.name: color-on-success
tokens.usage: Text/icons on a solid `success` fill (done tick).

tokens.name: color-success-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Success icon on the inverse (toast) surface.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Excess (+) and soft alerts. Text/border on `bg` and `warning-subtle` (7.1:1 light). Reserved for state.

tokens.name: color-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background for soft-alert banner, Excess value, matched-late calendar cell.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Short (-), hard errors, Not matched. Text/border on `bg` and `danger-subtle` (7.6:1 light). Reserved for state.

tokens.name: color-danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background for error banner, Short value, Not matched pill.

tokens.name: color-on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on solid `danger` fill: destructive button, count badge, error toast.

tokens.name: color-hsd
tokens.usage: HSD tag text and MS/HSD price chip text on `hsd-tint`. Product identity only.

tokens.name: color-hsd-tint
tokens.usage: HSD tag and row-accent background.

tokens.name: color-ms
tokens.usage: MS tag text on `ms-tint`. Product identity only.

tokens.name: color-ms-tint
tokens.usage: MS tag and row-accent background.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and card titles, nozzle Sales.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body text. Minimum size for anything a user must read or act on.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, helper text, pills. Not for errors or actions.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Non-critical only: unit hints, AUTO tag, opening-reading caption, tab labels.

styles.name: number-input
styles.usage: Numeric inputs and auto totals. Tabular figures.

styles.name: number-inline
styles.usage: Numbers inside lists, rows and sentences. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; tag/chip padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between fields in a row.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, card padding, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Between grouped sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Around big totals; sheet top spacing.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, page top spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, tags, segmented thumbs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, banners, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners) and the phone frame.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, switches, badges, progress bars.

shadow.note: Prefer 1px borders. Only sticky bars and bottom sheets get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky bottom action bar only.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, toasts and floating select lists only. Everything else uses a 1px border.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target.

tokens.name: button-l
tokens.usage: Large button, main action per screen.

tokens.name: button-m
tokens.usage: Medium button inside cards/banners (hit area padded to 48).

tokens.name: input-h
tokens.usage: Numeric/text input height.

tokens.name: nozzle-row-h
tokens.usage: Compact nozzle row height (fits 8 rows + 2 headers in ~590px).

tokens.name: icon-inline
tokens.usage: Lucide outline, 1.5px stroke, inline with text.

tokens.name: icon-nav
tokens.usage: Lucide outline, 1.5px stroke, navigation.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of entry screens on web, centred.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Left navigation rail width, web >=1024px.
